children: Westwater Resources presented updates on Kellyton construction, Coosa development and received a $25 million EXIM loan to advance commercial production.
Presented investor slide deck at H.C. Wainwright conference outlining mine-to-market plan and project milestones.
Kellyton plant under construction: >50% of $245M capital invested to date; Phase 1 target 12,500 mtpa CSPG.
Export-Import Bank approved a $25M direct loan to support Kellyton and non-dilutive path to production.
Coosa deposit: largest, most-advanced contiguous U.S. deposit; 2.3M st inferred at 3.21% grade and 22-year mine life per 2023 assessment.
Permitting underway for Coosa with key filings in 2026 and production expected late 2028/early 2029 pending reviews.
